reapack.name: Gumbo
reapack.desc: Gumbo - an SFZ instrument player: play SFZ sample libraries inside REAPER

metadata.description: Gumbo plays SFZ sample libraries inside REAPER, in one free JSFX. Pick an instrument in its browser (search and favourites) and play, or drop an SFZ library or a SoundFont (.sf2, .sf3) on its window. A four-band EQ with a tilt TONE, remembered per instrument and per program, drive, the library's own controls, pitch and mod wheels, drum pads with the sounds' names, icons and colours, and keys you can play from the mixer. With the Gumbo helper running, each track takes its instrument's name, colour and icon. Install Gumbo GM sounds from this repository for a whole General MIDI set; the VSCO 2 orchestra is a separate free download (the Gumbo-Sounds repository). Free to use; the code stays EON Studios' (Gumbo_LICENSE.md).

version.author: Quaz (EON Studios)
version.changelog: Instruments that change with how hard you play: SFZ filters, filter envelopes, vibrato and tremolo, and SoundFonts' own velocity, key and breath rules (soft notes darker and quieter, hard notes brighter). Instruments too big for memory are stored at 16-bit and load whole (about 3 GB of sound). A General MIDI set opens on its first program; drum pads and key names show only while a kit plays. Gumbo carries its own browser icons; the VSCO sounds moved to their own repository, Gumbo-Sounds.

source.file: ReaKit FX - Dock following the selected track.lua

version.author: Quaz (EON Studios)
version.changelog: A General MIDI set keeps its 16 channels apart: two instruments on the same note, one channel's sustain pedal, pitch bend, volume or all-notes-off no longer reach the others. A note played just as an instrument finishes loading now plays; a stray note-off no longer sounds a piano's release noise; a held articulation key no longer makes the next note count as connected. Re-importing a SoundFont keeps the earlier copy playing until the new one is complete, and a damaged SoundFont is refused without harm. An instrument whose sounds are all missing says it plays nothing.

source.file: ReaKit FX - Dock following the selected track.lua

version.author: Quaz (EON Studios)
version.changelog: Sounds: a sound can slide in pitch as it plays (SFZ pitch envelopes, a SoundFont's pitch envelope: an 808's drop, a brass scoop); low notes ring longer when a SoundFont asks for it; a library's own pitch-bend range and a MIDI file's bend-range message are honoured; a library's attack and release controls work on the CONTROLS page, the release even on notes already held; compressed SoundFonts (.sf3) and Ogg samples import and play; a GM set's variation banks (bank select) play. The face: the EQ belongs to each program of a GM set, flat until set, with a HOLD switch; Q knobs on the EQ; the keyboard and the display fold away; the side list files a GM set under its families, and a search can name the set; the MIDI editor's lanes take the kit's drum names; drum pads wear icons and family colours, each pad's own on a click, bold or soft; the typeface, text size and screen look can be saved as the default for new Gumbos; Gumbo opens embedded in the mixer. Drum names drop their file numbers; every kit names every key.

metadata.description: Gumbo GM: a whole General MIDI set for Gumbo in one instrument, the 128 programs and the drum kits, picked with the program box or by program changes, kits on channel 10. Made from MuseScore General by S. Christian Collins, from FluidR3 by Frank Wen and FluidR3Mono by Michael Cowgill, under the MIT licence; the notices are in MuseScore_General_License.md beside the sounds. About 80 MB to download, about 820 MB when loaded.

version.author: Quaz (EON Studios)
version.changelog: The first release: ten General MIDI instruments from the Discord SFZ GM Bank.

version.author: Quaz (EON Studios)
version.changelog: Gumbo GM: a whole General MIDI set in one Gumbo instrument, all 128 programs and the drum kits (MuseScore General, MIT). Replaces the ten Discord GM instruments of 1.0.0.

version.author: Quaz (EON Studios)
version.changelog: Every variation bank of MuseScore General (289 programs: the expressive banks, the extra kits) in the one instrument, picked by bank select or from the browser; each of the 37 kits names every key it plays; drum names without their file numbers; pitch envelopes and key-scaled decays carried from the SoundFont.
